_doc: Camera keyframes for the pipeline chart (visuals/pipeline@3x.png: the SVG at 3x, 1800x1013 canvas, the 1800x820 drawing 96 px down). box = [x, y, width] in SVG units (16:9, height follows) or "all"; hi = rectangles [x, y, w, h] kept bright, the rest dimmed, or "all". Each line's list: shots at a fraction (at) of that line's time.
